payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-004: Implement provider-agnostic LLM client and secret hygiene
payload.body:
## Summary

Add an internal interface from “structured review request” to **parsed JSON**, ship **one** concrete adapter (OpenAI-compatible HTTPS recommended in PRD), and ensure API keys and endpoints come only from **GitHub Actions secrets/variables** with no leakage in logs or PR comments.

## Scope

- In scope: Interface + first HTTP adapter; configurable base URL/model via env; redaction in logging; unit tests with mocked HTTP.
- Out of scope: Second vendor adapter beyond what’s needed to prove swap-ability (interface + one impl).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A **stable internal interface** exists (e.g. complete prompt → structured result) so swapping implementations does **not** require changing workflow YAML beyond **env vars / secret names**.
- [ ] **Unit tests mock the HTTP client** (no real network); tests assert request shape and response parsing.
- [ ] API key and endpoint are read **only** from GitHub Actions secrets/variables; **static review + tests** ensure `Authorization` headers and raw keys are **never** printed to logs or echoed in PR comments on success or failure paths.
- [ ] First shipped adapter matches the **OpenAI-compatible** chat/completions pattern unless engineering documents a different choice in this ticket’s Notes.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005

## Notes

PRD §5: on JSON validation failure, downstream should post a **generic** failure message without dumping raw model output — implement in GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005 but ensure this module does not log full responses containing secrets.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
